# Acme Corp

> Acme Corp makes SEO tools for startup founders and indie hackers who want to improve search visibility without hiring an agency.

Founded in 2020. Contact: hello@example.com. Format follows the llms.txt proposal (https://llmstxt.org/).

## Product

- [Features](https://example.com/features): what the tools do and which sites they suit
- [Pricing](https://example.com/pricing): plans, limits and the free tier

## Guides

- [Getting started](https://example.com/docs/getting-started): connect a site and run the first audit
- [Structured data guide](https://example.com/docs/structured-data): which schema types the tools generate

## Optional
